units.source_text: “天堂的我主基督，我做这个卑贱的生意，都是为了养活年老的父亲。

en.t: O Christ my Lord in heaven, I do this lowly trade only to support my aged father.

units.source_text: 但是我的生意只让我一个人脏污了，没有让别人受到连累。

en.t: But my trade has defiled only me; it has not dragged anyone else into harm.

units.source_text: 因此我认为，即使我以后死了，也定能上天堂。

en.t: For that reason, I believe that even if I die later, I will surely be able to go to heaven.

units.source_text: 但是现在我要是不把病传染给客人，我就不能再做这个生意了。

en.t: But now, unless I pass the disease on to my customers, I can no longer keep doing this trade.

units.source_text: 这么说来，即使要饿死——假如饿死了，这病也就无所谓了——我也一定得下定决定，绝对不能和客人同床了。

en.t: That being so, even if I must starve to death--and if I starve, this illness will no longer matter--I must make up my mind never to share a bed with a customer again.

units.source_text: 不然，就是为了自己的安稳，连累无辜的人。

en.t: Otherwise, for the sake of my own safety, I would involve innocent people.

units.source_text: 但是无论如何，我只是个女人，很容易被诱惑欺骗。

en.t: But whatever the case, I am only a woman, easily tempted and deceived.

units.source_text: 天堂的我主基督啊，请求你保佑我，因为除了你之外，我无依无靠。”

en.t: O Christ my Lord in heaven, please protect me, for apart from you I have no one to rely on.
